name: Send agreements for e-signature and file the signed copy
summary: Takes a prepared agreement, builds it as a DocuSign envelope kept in draft, queues the send for a person to approve, and tracks the signatures until the envelope is complete. Filing the signed copy into the business's own records is not built yet. Crons read and draft; a person approves every send.

covered_by.trigger-ready: not covered (the request arrives by form or email, outside this workflow)
covered_by.prepare-document: skill (the agreement PDF is prepared by the business and placed in the agreement record)
covered_by.place-signature-fields: not covered (the DocuSign tab placement is not built)
covered_by.set-signers: draft (signers are read from the agreement record and checked)
covered_by.send-for-signature: draft (envelope kept in DocuSign as created) and approval (the send)
covered_by.other: status (signature progress is read back from DocuSign)

crons.name: prepare
crons.summary: New agreements are checked, then built as a DocuSign envelope kept in draft. Nothing is emailed.

crons.name: dispatch
crons.summary: Each drafted envelope's send is queued for approval. Nothing is sent by the cron.

crons.name: status
crons.summary: Approved sends are marked sent, and signature progress is read back from DocuSign.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations reach nobody outside the business: an envelope saved as created (status is hard-coded to created, so DocuSign emails no one) and reads of an envelope's status. Changing an envelope to sent is the only live operation: it emails the signers, so it is queued and waits for a person.

docusign.covers: draft envelope from a PDF and signers, queued send, status read-back for sent, signed, completed, declined and voided

gaps: Intake: the request that starts an agreement (a Google Form, an Outlook request, practice software) is not read by this workflow. The agreement record is written by the business or the agent, and no command in the runtime adds one yet. Adding that command is a runtime change for core/, not built here.
Signature placement: DocuSign anchor tabs are not built, so signing fields still land where the document puts them. This is the 'signing fields over the wrong text' pain, and it stays open.
Signers from the source record: the owner wants signer details to fill in automatically from the source system. This build reads them from the agreement record, so that source still has to feed it.
Filing the signed copy: the signed PDF can be read through DocuSign's document operation, but no destination (ShiftCare participant folders, a document store) is mapped, so nothing is filed.
Record keeping: the register that auditors read is not built.
Chasing signers: a reminder needs the recipient resend operation, which is live and not built here.
Zoho: the Zoho docs in the platform docs cover PDF templates and mail merge only, with no signature fields, signer order or signed-copy storage described. No Zoho adapter.
PandaDoc, Ignition, RealWorks, Adobe Sign: not built here. Ignition, RealWorks and Adobe Sign are not in the kit's platform list. PandaDoc is mapped in the kit but has no adapter here.

The workflow is docs-only until a DocuSign developer sandbox (DOCUSIGN_ENV=demo) proves it against a real account. The DocuSign platform is marked offline-tested only, and its sign-in needs a one-time consent by the user.
